page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew lemmas with Latin glosses and biblical references. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Catchword "tum" at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: וּמִפְּרִיסֵי הַפַּרְסָה Et ex dividentibus ungulam, Lev.11.4. cum defectu ' in medio, juxta Maforethas. Fœm. פַּרְסָה Dividens, Lev.11.3. dicitur, tantùm in hac Conjugatione de Ungula animalium divisâ vel fcissâ.
פֶּרֶס m. Olsifraga, aquilæ speciesimmunda, Levit.11.13. Alii aliter.

פָּרְסָה f. Ungula, à Fissura, Levit.11.3. Plural. פָּרְסוֹת Ungula, Lev.11.3. Constr. פָּרְסוֹת Jef.5.28. Aff. וּפָרְסָתְךָ Et ungulas tuas, Mich.4.13. Et masc. וּפָרְסֵיהֶן Et ungulas earum, Zach.11.16.

פָּרַע Nudavit, Retexit: Abstraxit, Abjecit, Rejecit, Deseruit: Abstraxit se, Recessit, Aversit se, Retrocessit: Item Ulus est, ex usu Chaldaico: Præter. וּפָרַע Et reteget, Num.5.18. כִּי פָּרְעָה Quòd nudasset eum, Exod.32.25. Partic. præsens, פּוֹרֵעַ Abstrahens, Rejiciens, Prov.13.18. Partic. passivum, פָּרוּעַ Retectum, Lev.13.45. Infin. בִּפְרַע In ulciscendo, Jud.5.2. Imperat. פִּרְעֵהוּ Abstrahe, Abjice eam, Prov.4.15. Fut. אֶפְרַע Abstra-ham me, Retrocedam, Ezech.24.14. יִפְרַע Reteget, Lev.21. v.10. תִּפְרְעוּ Abstrahite vos, Prov.8.33. וַתִּפְרַע Et rejecistis, Prov.1.25. Niph. Futur. יִפָּרַע Abstrahitur, Averti se, Prov.29.18. Hiph. Præt. הִפְרִיעַ Abstractionem vel Aversionem fecerat, scil. Rex Achas, 2.Par.28.19. Fut. תַּפְרִיעוּ Abstrahitis, Exod.5.4.
פֶּרַע m. Coma, Num.6.5. quia quò magis nutritur, eò magis Retegitur.
פְּרָעָה f. Ultio: Plural. פִּרְעוֹת Ultiones, Judic.5. v.2[?]. Constr. פִּרְעוֹת Deut.32.42.
* פָּרַשׂ m. Pulex: אַחֲרֵי פָּרַשׂ אֶחָד Post pulicem unum, 1.Sam.24.15.
פָּרַץ Rupit, Erupit, Disrupit, Irrupit, Perrupit, Rupturam fecit, Effregit: Item, Ursit, Insiticit,

page.notes: The first Hebrew line carries a niqqud pattern that is hard to read at this scale; the vowel points in the lemmas may be slightly off. "v.2" after Judic.5 is unclear and marked [?]. The large initial lemma פָּרַץ is a woodcut-sized letter set as the first word of its entry. The entry continues on the next page with "tum" as catchword. No marginal notes or signature visible.
